valeGate.finding: ReadPipeline can merge styles/.vale-config sources even with no-global. Manager loads defaults plus configured style files and individual checks, compiles/inherits definitions then filters. Do not equate one local YAML with a complete dependency audit.
valeGate.limits: Counts attest effective named checks in this controlled run, not all compiled or linked code. Missing pipeline directory is a point-in-time observation, not protection from later changes; no filesystem lock.
